labels.rationale: Rich already supports orange via style names (orange1, dark_orange) or hex colours; this is a usage question.

body:
Rich already supports orange text. Pass a colour name to `style`, for example `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")`, or a hex colour such as `style="#ffa500"`. The colour names are listed in the [style docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst) and the [colours appendix](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst).

If you have a question about how to use Rich, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
